name: x96dbg（KSword 后端）
description: Starts standalone 64-bit x64dbg with the canonical TitanEngine KSword adapter and a themed KSword control/log Tab. Native forwarding is usable without the KSword driver.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Start standalone x64dbg and attach to the selected process through the KSword engine adapter.

commands.name: tab
commands.description: Start standalone x64dbg with a KSword control/log Tab and acknowledged HVM selection.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate the required x64 payload files without launching a debugger.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Print capabilities and payload readiness as JSON Lines without launching a debugger.
